features.text: Child-specific sizing provides better fit than adapted adult boots
Lightweight nylon struts deliver stable support without excess weight
Washable deluxe foam liner ensures hygiene throughout the recovery period
Rocker bottom design helps kids maintain natural walking patterns
Easy-adjust straps accommodate growth and varying levels of swelling
Durable construction withstands active children's daily activities

measurement: Refer to our sizing chart for proper measurements, or visit our Perfect Fit Promise page for personalized fitting assistance from our medical team. Proper sizing is crucial for children's comfort and recovery.
